hook: My relative **died without a will.** Who gets the property?

slides.title: First: **which law** applies?
list: Hindus, Buddhists, Jains, Sikhs: Hindu Succession Act
Muslims: Muslim Personal Law, except farm land
Christians, Parsis: generally Indian Succession Act
Scheduled Tribes: HSA only if the Centre notifies
slides.ref: HSA 1956 · Sec 2; Shariat Act 1937 · Sec 2; ISA 1925 · Sec 29; Uttarakhand UCC 2024
slides.note: Uttarakhand: its own Uniform Civil Code

slides.title: A man dies: **Class I** heirs first.
slides.body: Under the Hindu Succession Act, his property goes first to Class I heirs. They include his sons, daughters, widow and mother, and children of a son or daughter who died before him.
slides.ref: Hindu Succession Act 1956 · Sec 8(a), Schedule Class I

slides.title: Class I heirs **share together.**
slides.body: They all inherit at once, excluding other heirs. His widow (or all widows together) takes one share; each surviving son and daughter, and his mother, takes one share.
slides.ref: Hindu Succession Act 1956 · Sec 9, Sec 10 Rules 1–2

slides.title: No Class I heir? **Next in line.**
A woman dies: **a different order.**
list: 1st: sons, daughters (incl. children of a pre-deceased child) and husband
Then father's heirs, and lastly mother's heirs

slides.title: Inherited property? **A special rule.**
slides.body: If she leaves no son or daughter, property she inherited from her father or mother goes to her father's heirs; property from her husband or father-in-law goes to her husband's heirs.

sources: Hindu Succession Act, 1956 (as amended in 2005) – Sections 2, 8, 9, 10, 15 and Schedule
Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1937 – Section 2
Uniform Civil Code, Uttarakhand, 2024 (in force 27 Jan 2025, PIB) and UCC Rules 2025 (ucc.uk.gov.in)
caption:
Someone in the family died without a will? Here's who inherits. 👇

1️⃣ First check which law applies: Hindus, Buddhists, Jains and Sikhs follow the Hindu Succession Act, 1956; Muslims follow Muslim Personal Law; Christians and Parsis generally follow the Indian Succession Act, 1925. In Uttarakhand, the State's Uniform Civil Code, 2024 now applies to residents (except Scheduled Tribes)
2️⃣ When a Hindu man dies, Class I heirs inherit first: sons, daughters, widow, mother and others listed
3️⃣ They inherit together; the widow (all widows together), each son, each daughter and the mother get one share each
4️⃣ No Class I heir? Then Class II heirs, then agnates, then cognates
5️⃣ When a Hindu woman dies, her children and husband come first, then her husband's heirs, then her parents

Source: Hindu Succession Act, 1956 (Sec 2, 8, 9, 10, 15, Schedule); Shariat Act, 1937 (Sec 2); Indian Succession Act, 1925 (Sec 29)
